hooks.command: input=$(cat) && echo "$input" | grep -qiE '(DROP|DELETE|TRUNCATE|CREATE\s+OR\s+REPLACE|INSERT|UPDATE|MERGE)' && echo 'Impact Radar is read-only. It only uses GET_LINEAGE and git diff.' && exit 2 || true
input=$(cat) && echo "$input" | grep -qE '(\.env"|connections\.toml|.pem"|credentials)' && echo 'Reading credential files is not allowed.' && exit 2 || true
